messages:
jordan: Quick one-liner challenge to kick the week — sum up your Monday in one mic-drop line. Go.

sophie: Coffee: 1, me: 0. :coffee:

nate: My plants judged me for being late. They were correct. :palm_tree:

ramona: Currently negotiating with my snooze button. It keeps winning. :sleeping:

leo: I sent an email to a meeting and now the meeting moved into my inbox. 

jordan: @sophie nailed it. Also, kudos to @ramona for rescuing the snack drawer yesterday :raised_hands:

dev-bot: Reminder: Friday snacks restock vote closes Thursday 17:00. React with :pizza: or :cookie: to vote.

sophie: :cookie: obviously. High-brow pastry taste.

nate: :pizza: tactical carbs for sprinting to standups.

ramona: Tie-breaker suggestion: croissant-Stanford hybrid. (I made that word up.)

leo: One-liner add — My calendar is a choose-your-own-adventure with poor outcomes.

jordan: OK bonus round — funniest two-word status you saw today?

sophie: "Buffering optimist"

nate: "Email archaeologist"

ramona: Quick shout: @leo fixed the coffee machine this morning, hero energy. :trophy:

leo: I accept the trophy and the passive-aggressive thank-you notes.

jordan: All right, mic-drop winners: @sophie for honesty, @leo for heroics. Small prize: bragging rights and one cookie. :cookie:

dev-bot: Poll closed: cookies 62%, pizza 38% (sample size: the snack committee and approx. 7 freelancers).

nate: See you at the cookie table. (I'll bring napkins.) :grin:

jordan: Thread closed on a high note. Thanks y'all — keep the one-liners coming.
